title: designfuchen/word-atlas
why_read: A well-made vocabulary learning app and open dataset for IELTS English test preparation, useful mainly to language learners rather than software engineers.
analysis: This project pairs illustrated flashcards with native audio and spaced-repetition scheduling (FSRS) to help learners memorize English vocabulary for the IELTS exam. The use of FSRS, a modern spaced-repetition algorithm, is a mildly interesting technical detail, but the project overall is an educational content app rather than an engineering tool. It is open source and includes a CC-licensed dataset, which could be reused by other developers building similar language-learning apps. Overall, its appeal is narrow and mostly outside core software engineering interests.
